datasets.name: Watcher's Eye
datasets.description: Search every two-mod pair, or value three-mod eyes from their strongest pair.
datasets.assumption: Equal pair probabilities are an assumption. Prices are the cheapest asking listings containing both mods, not completed sales. Three-mod values use the maximum of their three pair prices; they are modelled, not observed triple listings.
